access.bad_node: `{value}` is not a valid node pattern ({reason}). Use a dotted node; the last segment may be `*`, e.g. `team.acme.packages.read` or `team.acme.*`.
access.bind.added: Bound: anyone holding `{node}` gets {role}. Run `/access sync` to reconcile now (or `dry_run:true` to preview).
access.list.configured: *SMAS is configured; bindings only decide which roles `sync` adds or removes.*
access.list.empty: No bindings yet. Create one with `/access bind <node> <role>`.
access.list.title: Node → role bindings
access.status.not_linked: {member} has no linked GitHub account, so their roles cannot be computed.

access.status.title: SMAS permissions of {member}
access.sync.dry_note: *This was a preview; no roles were changed. Run it again without `dry_run` to apply.*

access.sync.title: Synced
access.unbind.done: Removed **{count}** binding(s) for `{node}`. Roles already granted are **not** revoked automatically — the next `/access sync` does that.
access.unbind.title: Unbound
